title: Crown of Life
description: Gives Minecraft a peaceful theme, centered around Jesus.
body:
![Title screen w/ pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/TWHSYnOG/images/3588d84a2a752195e0175049a32f84545007d14f.png)

### Gives Minecraft a peaceful theme, centered around Jesus.

In this pack, you'll find lots of _gold_ textures, and nice splash texts to encourge you with different bible verses.

I made this resource pack because I love Jesus and it's a great way to put it into something that people play a lot, including myself!
